FOCUS INVESTED WARDING

Level 11; Armour Price 11,000 gp; Shield Price 7,700 gp; Usage inscribed onto armour or shield; Activate Engage (1 AP); Requirement the rune is ready

This rune enhances the wearer's inner balance and agility.

Activate the rune to gain a +2 dodge bonus to DB and a +2 resistance bonus to saving throws for 1 minute. This bonus increases to +3 if you are a Disciple or Mystic. The rune then becomes expended and can be restored with Refocus.

On the sheet: Press Harmony on the item (Engage, 1 AP): for 1 minute +2 dodge DB and +2 resistance to all three saves, +3 each when you have the Disciple or Mystic class. The rune is then expended; Refocus restores it.
